cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22.1)

project(formsnap_processor LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

set(FORMSNAP_NATIVE_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}")

# OpenCV 5.0.0 Android SDK is generated by CI from the top-level
# opencv2 source submodule. The Form Snap native source layout remains:
#   cpp/CMakeLists.txt
#   cpp/native-lib.cpp
#   cpp/native-lib.h
set(OPENCV_SDK_ROOT
    "${FORMSNAP_NATIVE_ROOT}/../../../../../opencv2/android-sdk/sdk"
)

set(OPENCV_INCLUDE_DIR
    "${OPENCV_SDK_ROOT}/native/jni/include"
)

set(OPENCV_LIBRARY
    "${OPENCV_SDK_ROOT}/native/libs/${ANDROID_ABI}/libopencv_java5.so"
)

if(NOT EXISTS "${OPENCV_INCLUDE_DIR}/opencv2/core.hpp")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "OpenCV 5.0.0 headers not found: ${OPENCV_INCLUDE_DIR}"
    )
endif()

if(NOT EXISTS "${OPENCV_LIBRARY}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "OpenCV 5.0.0 native library not found for ABI ${ANDROID_ABI}: "
        "${OPENCV_LIBRARY}"
    )
endif()

add_library(opencv_java5 SHARED IMPORTED GLOBAL)

set_target_properties(opencv_java5 PROPERTIES
    IMPORTED_LOCATION "${OPENCV_LIBRARY}"
    INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${OPENCV_INCLUDE_DIR}"
)

add_library(formsnap_processor SHARED native-lib.cpp)

target_include_directories(formsnap_processor
    PRIVATE
        "${FORMSNAP_NATIVE_ROOT}"
        "${OPENCV_INCLUDE_DIR}"
)

target_link_libraries(formsnap_processor
    PRIVATE
        opencv_java5
        android
        log
)

set_target_properties(formsnap_processor PROPERTIES
    POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON
    CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
    VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN ON
)

target_compile_options(formsnap_processor
    PRIVATE
        -Wall
        -Wextra
        -Wpedantic
        -ffunction-sections
        -fdata-sections
)

target_link_options(formsnap_processor
    PRIVATE
        -Wl,--gc-sections
        -Wl,--exclude-libs,ALL
)
